text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Casablanca city council unanimously approves takeover by French Lyonnaise des Eaux of water and electricity distribution.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali attends Euro-Mediterranean conference in Malta.
- State-owned Office National des Aeroports (ONDA) trains 170 Palestinian technical staff who will operate Gaza Airport.
- Opposition parties give go-ahead to concession deal to France's Lyonnaise des Eaux for management of Casablanca water and electricity distribution after initial deal has been amended.
- Arab fund grants Morocco $38.25 million to finance imports of crude phosphorus from Saudi Arabia and Kuwait to cover needs of state-owned Office Cherifien des Phosphates.
- Moroccan Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj and Palestinian counterpart Mohammed Zuhdi Al-Nashashibi express willingness to strengthen cooperation notably in building and aeronautics.
